statement: GL-free admission plans inclusive day/night, 120-second weather and three-day schedules with exact ticks, rational bursts and final-tick holds under 4096-frame and 10-million-tick ceilings. The sequence execution protocol re-admits immutable plans and checks aggregate transport-provided frame/manifest byte reservations against a caller-lowered 512 GiB ceiling before executable steps. It requests and verifies individual simulation ticks, bounds frozen warmup/readiness/settling and presentation substeps, derives calendar phase from ticks and carries explicit lighting controls. Sticky refusal and a final publication acknowledgement prevent partial captures from becoming complete in the protocol. Registered regressions cover schedules, readiness, phase, budgets, clock/transport faults and real creature-brain progression matching ordinary fixed ticking. Both shipping startup parsers still refuse temporal execution before output. Fixed-site app/simulation/A4 transport wiring, enforceable transport byte bounds, weather input, capability checks, existing-frontier native capture and assembly remain pending; no temporal or all-features runtime support is claimed.

evidence.planned: Integrate and validate fixed-site simulation and completed-frame transport before native temporal capture; owner: maintainers
